 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0033
 Dylan Thomas, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
10-26-24
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
For its affirmative defenses, Defendant sttaes as follows. First, Plaintiff's alleged injuries and damages were not
proximately caused by any negligence on the part of Defendant. The collision was of such low speed that the forces
involved could not have produced the injuries claimed, and any conditions Plaintiff now asserts were pre-existing or
unrelated to the incident.
Second, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice, delaying treatment, or
incurring expenses that were unnecessary or unreasonable in amount. Any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
Third, to the extent Plaintiff's own careless operation of his or her vehicle contributed to the collision, Defendant
invokes Texas proportionate responsibility under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code. Any
damages awarded must be reduced by the percentage of responsibility attributed to Plaintiff, and recovery is barred if
Plaintiff's share exceeds fifty percent.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
